6662-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a 2/2 green Bird creature token with its own landfall ability
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

512-7014-8190.easyPrerequisites: Loot and North Pole Patrol do not have summoning sickness.
512-7014-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with different powers.
512-7014-8190.description:
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping North Pole Patrol and Loot, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the North Pole Patrol ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-7014-8190.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Loot's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

147-1070-2438.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1070-2438.description:
Cast Rise Again by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Rise Again.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Rise Again
Resolve the Rise Again copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

728-1579-6972--112.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Visionary Augmenter.
When Visionary Augmenter dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Visionary Augmenter enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
728-1579-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Visionary Augmenter's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

4681-5170-6094-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

5256-6012--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
5256-6012--5--195.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Reluctant Role Model trigger.
Resolve Reluctant Role Model's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

573-1257-7857.description:
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Elven Raft-Steerer trigger.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elven Raft-Steerer trigger, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1362-1462-2929.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield as an enchantment due to Enchanted Evening, Composer of Spring triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning Oboro from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Composer of Spring trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1418-3821-4415.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
1418-3821-4415.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Stonecloaker by paying its mana cost.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4508-7223-7746.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4508-7223-7746.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as HYDRA Assault Robot is a Pirate due to Stalactite Dagger, creating a Treasure token
When the Treasure enters, HYDRA Assault Robot triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

457-698-1458-4404.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness.
457-698-1458-4404.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
Cast Corridor Monitor by paying {U} due to Will.
When Corridor Monitor enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Corridor Monitor, adding {U}.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Corridor Monitor from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 3.

141-5256-7335.easyPrerequisites: There is a valid target for Pain 101 on the battlefield.
141-5256-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4373-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4373-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Ghalta and Mavren as attackers.
Ghalta and Mavren triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4934-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Amareth triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to look at the top card of your library, which will be Sensei's Divining Top, and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

2366-4452-4693-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-4452-4693-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Overgrown Estate ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1323-4762-7061.notablePrerequisites: Experiment Kraj does not have summoning sickness.
1323-4762-7061.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters onto Devoted Druid.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj's own ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Remove the -1/-1 counter and one of the +1/+1 counters from Experiment Kraj as a state-based action.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 any number of times, resulting in any number of +1/+1 counters on Experiment Kraj.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's last ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on itself, untapping it.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, add {G}.
Repeat steps 6 and 7 any number of times.
You may also activate Experiment Kraj's own ability any number of times instead of step 7, putting any number of +1/+1 counters onto creatures.

Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-1483-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Weaponcraft Enthusiast's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

141-6798-6816.description:
Cast Infuse with Vitality by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Infuse with Vitality, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Infuse with Vitality.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.

1497-2173-5220-5931.description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it.
When Wild Cantor dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room // Awakening Hall trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Wild Cantor from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

4210-5670-6792--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
4210-5670-6792--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Wayward Disciple trigger if its on the battlefield.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, if applicable, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Pious Evangel triggers if its on the battlefield, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

222-527-5295-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5295-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

requires.n: Vehicle with MV >= 3 and a Crew Ability

4659-5747-6243--123.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Vehicle with MV >= 3.
The number of artifacts you control is equal to or greater than the Vehicle's crew number minus 2.
4659-5747-6243--123.description:
Cast the Vehicle by paying its mana cost.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping the Construct, causing the Vehicle to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Vehicle.
When the Vehicle dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the Vehicle from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not be an Angel because the Vehicle is no longer a creature and cannot gain creature types.
When the Vehicle enters the battlefield, Simulacrum Synthesizer triggers, creating a 0/0 Construct artifact creature token that gets +1/+1 for each artifact you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3000-3124-5670.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional green creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
3000-3124-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another green creature.
When the creature dies, Savra's second ability triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1339-1479-3478-6674.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
1339-1479-3478-6674.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Rydia trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1170-1328-4251-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any Samurai you control.
1170-1328-4251-6633.description:
Declare Godo and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Godo's second ability triggers, causing you to untap it and all Samurai you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Godo.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

500-851-1270-2523.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Ojer Taq and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Ojer Taq token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Ojer Taqs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2*(3^X) nonlegendary token copies of Ojer Taq that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Ojer Taqs you control.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-1270-2523.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^695.6224481408007) creature tokens.

222-527-1849-2438.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-1849-2438.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2558-2829-4742-5687.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Nahiri's Resolve, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2292-2792-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
2292-2792-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Great Whale, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

974-4896-5470.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
High Alert attached to Ghired.
974-4896-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}{U}.
Activate High Alert by paying {2}{W}{U}, untapping Ghired.
Repeat from step 3.
974-4896-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

2232-3136-4050-5649.description:
Cast Changeling Outcast by paying {B}.
When Changeling Outcast enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Bladewing's Thrall trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Changeling Outcast from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1994-2021-4802-4969.easyPrerequisites: Eldrazi Conscription attached to Master Biomancer.
1994-2021-4802-4969.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Belt of Giant Strength attached to Master Biomancer.
1994-2021-4802-4969.description:
Cause another creature to enter the battlefield under your control with at least 20 +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Simic Ascendancy's second ability triggers, putting 20 growth counters on Simic Ascendancy.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy's third ability triggers, causing you to win the game.

328-338-1409-2060.notablePrerequisites:
Light of Promise attached to Crystalline Crawler.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
328-338-1409-2060.description:
Activate Gray Merchant of Asphodel by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Gray Merchant of Asphodel enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Gray Merchant of Asphodel.
Resolve the Gray Merchant of Asphodel trigger, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain that much life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting at least two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If your devotion to black is at least three, this combo nets infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and infinite mana.

141-997-3047.description:
Cast Feign Death by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Feign Death, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Feign Death.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

844-951-2232-2972-3023.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
When Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3781-3946-4011.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional land.
3781-3946-4011.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Pass the turn.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Play a land except Glacial Chasm from your graveyard.
Repeat.

1823-2584-2864-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature with toughness six or less.
You do not control an Army.
1823-2584-2864-5231.description:
Activate That Which Was Taken by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a divinity counter on a creature an opponent controls with toughness six or less.
Activate Fall of Cair Andros by paying {7}{R}, dealing seven damage to the creature that has a divinity counter on it.
Fall of Cair Andros triggers, creating a 0/0 Army and putting at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Army enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers.
Holding priority, Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Army, adding {R}.
Resolve the Pandemonium trigger, dealing 1 damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite red mana, with a Pandemonium trigger on the stack, you may use Fall of Cair Andros' ability to deal infinite damage to the creature with a divinity counter on it, thus causing the Army to have infinite +1/+1 counters on it, which causes the Pandemonium trigger to deal infinite damage to any target.

662-2247-4312.notablePrerequisites:
Vorel does not have summoning sickness.
Teferi has at least six loyalty counters on it.
662-2247-4312.description:
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Teferi to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Activate Teferi's third loyalty ability by removing ten loyalty counters from it, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Teferi to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Teferi's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, causing you to loot.
Activate Vorel by paying {G}{U} and tapping it, doubling the number of loyalty counters on Teferi.
Move to your second extra turn.
Repeat.

681-1644-2167-4423-4826.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and two additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
681-1644-2167-4423-4826.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and two other lands, adding {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Each land enters the battlefield, triggering Tatyova that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
 Repeat.
